name: 1-propyl-5-MeO-AMT
summary: 1-Propyl-5-MeO-AMT, also known as 1-propyl-5-methoxy-α-methyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and 5-methoxytryptamine families. It is the 1-propyl derivative of 5-methoxy-α-methyltryptamine (5-MeO-AMT).

pharmacology.text: 1-Propyl-5-MeO-AMT, also known as 1-propyl-5-methoxy-α-methyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and 5-methoxytryptamine families. Whereas most tryptamines are highly non-selective in terms of binding to serotonin receptors, 1-propyl-5-MeO-AMT shows selectivity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor modulator

uses.text: The drug was developed by Richard Glennon and colleagues and was first described in 1990.

fact.en: It was made by Richard Glennon's group as a tool for telling serotonin receptor subtypes apart, because it is unusually picky about which ones it binds.
fact.zh: 它由Richard Glennon的研究團隊製造，作為區分血清素受體亞型的工具，因為它對結合哪些受體異常挑剔。
fact.zhHans: 它由Richard Glennon的研究团队制造，作为区分血清素受体亚型的工具，因为它对结合哪些受体异常挑剔。
